preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(P) <= 1000000 for P in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each passageway string P has a length between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.
The total length of all passageway strings P across all test cases is at most 5,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(P[0] == '#' and P[-1] == '#' for P in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each passageway string P starts and ends with a '#' character.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in '#.' for c in P) for P in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each passageway string P consists only of '#' and '.' characters.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(days, int) and days >= 0 for days in output)
postconditions.description: Each output value is a non-negative integer representing the number of days.

postconditions.expression: all(days == sum(1 for i in range(1, len(P)) if P[i] == '.' and (i == 1 or P[i-1] == '#')) for days, P in zip(output, test_cases))
postconditions.description: Each output value correctly calculates the number of days required to cross the corresponding passageway.
